name: Āpiti farm soil-conservation GIS study, 1993
description: 1993 farm soil-conservation GIS research in the Āpiti district
story: Massey University soil-science research in 1993 used a farm case study near Āpiti to demonstrate how GIS could support land-resource management and soil-conservation decisions. C. S. N. Priyono's thesis and a New Zealand Soil News abstract document the work and its three named authors.
